title: Hungry with a known ration: eat before the timer reaches starvation
citations: the M3 triage's four starvation deaths
construction: Dwarf Priest CL1, 14/14 HP, D1, food 100, one known ration, no monsters. The dossier gives the starvation shape; the ration and the open room are constructed.
limits: A constructed state. It checks the food action and the threshold, not a rescue of the recorded starvation (that run had no known food).

forbidden.item: resting while the food timer runs down
